metadata.indication: Adjuvant HER2-positive, node-negative breast cancer with tumour ≤3 cm

ongoing: Cardiac function, LFTs and creatinine every12weeks; cardiac4–8weekly if signs of impairment
source_monitoring.timeline: Baseline before firstdose; week12 reassessment at combination completion/beforeweek13; then12weekly through antibodyphase. No mandatory patient-entered date.
source_monitoring.imaging: No mandated universal CT/PET/DEXA; disease and other therapies determine these.

metadata.schedule_summary: Paclitaxel and IV trastuzumab weekly for 12 weeks, then trastuzumab alone to complete one year total. Continuation can be weekly or every 3 weeks under the source-specific plan; the treatment aim remains adjuvant.
metadata.dose_level_context: Paclitaxel source reduction ladder 80 / 65 / 50 mg/m². The toxicity-specific action determines whether it applies; neuropathy and hepatic instructions differ.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of the NCCP source document. It does not replace the current NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review, or pharmacy verification.

administration.notes: Initial loading 4 mg/kg; verify prior treatment / missed doses.

administration.note: Paclitaxel source reduction ladder 80 / 65 / 50 mg/m². The toxicity-specific action determines whether it applies; neuropathy and hepatic instructions differ.

administration.notes: Continue weekly 2 mg/kg OR q21-day 6 mg/kg under the agreed plan, to complete one year total. Retain adjuvant context.
Weekly continuation to complete one total year of trastuzumab.

renal_input.reason: Retain exact measured creatinine clearance so decimal gaps between the source bands are surfaced for review rather than rounded into a dose band.

output_templates.proceed: No encoded action was triggered by the supplied values. Unassessed domains and the full prescribing review remain outstanding.

output_templates.discontinue: Discontinue the affected component(s) identified below and obtain treating-clinician review.
output_templates.withhold: Withhold the affected component(s) and assess the reported problem.
output_templates.delay: Delay the affected component(s) pending source-defined recovery and review.
output_templates.dose_reduce: A component-specific dose modification applies; verify the original and current doses before prescribing.
